title: Meraki Winter 2022: Among the Stars
summary: Poetry, fiction and non-fiction about the sky, the galaxies and the questions they raise.
intro: From our deepest existential questions to reminiscence to crazy scientific theories, we have tried to cover it all.
editors: Editor-in-Chief: Saniya Mirza. Editors: Vikram Venkat, Cassandra Rifflin C.R.

articles.heading: From the Editor in Chief
articles.author: Saniya Mirza
articles.body:
It is with great pleasure that I introduce the Winter Edition of Meraki'22 to you all.

I remember being young and going on many road trips with my family. I would sit near the window and stare at the sky; at the beautiful stars, and I would get lost in the vast expanse of this blanket of tiny dots.

We, the editorial board, have carefully curated a selection of entries from some of our brilliant writers, photographers and artists on campus.
